selection: union of every equally shortest directed route within four edges, plus all declared endpoints; preserve all original induced edges
edge_semantics: unsigned measured synapse counts; no neurotransmitter or functional sign inferred
unreachable_policy: report every absent pair; never silently discard an endpoint or invent an edge
side_policy: report somaSide and rootSide independently; haltere afferent side uses annotated rootSide, not an invented soma side
scope: structural candidate only, no physiological motor mapping or vehicle control
